actions.title: Prepare the live hygiene fixture
actions.instruction: Run the installed Academy Prepare command from the clean learner checkout. Use the attempt number Academy prints; do not type a placeholder branch name.
actions.rationale: Prepare creates the externally recorded fixture and a numbered attempt without precomputing the learner report.
actions.expected_result: Academy creates and switches to academy/P08-repository-hygiene/<attempt> and reports the prepared fixture.
actions.recovery: If Prepare refuses, preserve its message and return to the documented dirty-state or existing-attempt recovery before retrying.
actions.evidence: The numbered branch is the only branch where P08 evidence may be committed.

actions.title: Freeze a native-terminal inventory
actions.instruction: Record the complete local-head ref view and the porcelain worktree view before asking for a classification.
actions.rationale: A complete observation prevents a report from silently omitting a prepared ref or worktree.

variants.command:
git for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)' refs/heads
git worktree list --porcelain

git for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)' refs/heads
git worktree list --porcelain

git for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)' refs/heads
git worktree list --porcelain

actions.expected_result: Git prints every local branch ref with its object ID and every registered worktree with its branch or HEAD binding.
actions.recovery: If either command says this is not a repository, stop and return to the prepared learner checkout. Do not invent an inventory.
actions.evidence: The observed sets are the source for the draft report and later learner review.

actions.title: Inspect through a harness shell
actions.instruction: Use this only when running the same Git inspection from the selected harness shell. The leading exclamation mark belongs only to the shell command.
actions.rationale: The harness shell is a distinct execution surface from a native terminal and from CodeArbiter commands.
actions.expected_result: The harness returns the same complete ref and worktree inventory that a native-terminal command would return.
actions.recovery: If the harness cannot run its shell, use the native-terminal inventory action instead. Do not use a CodeArbiter command as a shell substitute.
actions.evidence: The leading exclamation mark identifies this as a harness shell command, not an agent command.

actions.title: Ask the agent to classify, not clean up
actions.instruction: Run the agent-owned CodeArbiter standup command. Stop any proposed cleanup action and limit the result to inventory and classification advice.
actions.rationale: Standup can organize evidence but does not grant authority to discard live repository state.
actions.expected_result: The agent presents repository state for review without deleting, pruning, or rewriting any ref or worktree.
actions.recovery: If the response proposes cleanup, stop it and return to the frozen Git inventory. Preserve the current state.
actions.evidence: The learner retains the inventory and the decision to accept or reject any later report draft.

actions.title: Request a harness-text report draft
actions.instruction: Paste the text request into the active harness. It is a request to the agent, not a shell command and not a CodeArbiter command.
actions.rationale: The agent may draft the canonical report, while the learner remains responsible for reviewing its classifications and commit boundary.

variants.command: Draft .codearbiter/reports/academy/P08-hygiene.json from the current live P08 refs and worktrees. Preserve every live resource. Do not delete, prune, force, or rewrite anything. Wait for my review before staging or committing.

Draft .codearbiter/reports/academy/P08-hygiene.json from the current live P08 refs and worktrees. Preserve every live resource. Do not delete, prune, force, or rewrite anything. Wait for my review before staging or committing.

Draft .codearbiter/reports/academy/P08-hygiene.json from the current live P08 refs and worktrees. Preserve every live resource. Do not delete, prune, force, or rewrite anything. Wait for my review before staging or committing.

actions.expected_result: The agent creates a draft report without staging, committing, or changing the live fixture.
actions.recovery: If the agent changes state or drafts an incomplete report, preserve the attempt and request a corrected report from the current inventory.
actions.evidence: A reviewable draft exists at the exact P08 report path before the commit gate is considered.

actions.title: Review the agent draft
actions.instruction: Review the draft against the complete inventory. Confirm all five refs and three worktrees are present, path-free, correctly bound, and conservatively classified before authorizing a commit.
actions.rationale: A complete report is evidence of a learner-reviewed classification, not an agent decision delegated without inspection.
actions.expected_result: You can identify each preserved resource and the one merged-clean item eligible only for explicit future review.
actions.recovery: If a fact is missing, stale, path-bearing, or classified as removable, reject the draft and preserve the fixture while requesting a correction.
actions.evidence: The learner has reviewed the exact report that may become the sole evidence commit.

actions.title: Stage only the reviewed hygiene report
actions.instruction: Run the native-terminal command for your operating system. It stages only the reviewed report; do not use git add . or add any other path.
actions.rationale: The cached-diff review and commit gate require a precise, learner-controlled evidence boundary.
actions.expected_result: Git stages exactly .codearbiter/reports/academy/P08-hygiene.json and prints no output.
actions.recovery: If staging fails, preserve the draft and confirm the exact report path. If another path is already staged, stop before review and preserve that work for the applicable recovery path.
actions.evidence: The index now contains the one reviewed report that the cached diff must show.

actions.title: Review the staged evidence boundary
actions.instruction: After the reviewed report is staged, inspect the staged path list and diff. Continue only when the report is the sole staged file.
actions.rationale: P08 Check accepts one evidence commit containing only the canonical report.
actions.expected_result: The staged path list contains only .codearbiter/reports/academy/P08-hygiene.json and the diff matches the reviewed draft.
actions.recovery: If another path is staged, stop before the commit gate. Preserve the state and use the applicable recovery path instead of unstaging by guesswork.
actions.evidence: The learner has independently checked the exact evidence boundary.

actions.title: Run the agent-owned commit gate
actions.instruction: After learner review, run the CodeArbiter commit gate for the one staged P08 report. Do not add unrelated files or broaden the change.
actions.rationale: The governed commit preserves a precise evidence boundary for external verification.
actions.expected_result: The commit gate creates one report-only evidence commit on the numbered attempt.
actions.recovery: If the gate blocks, preserve its output and the live fixture. Correct only the reported evidence issue or use Reset for a new attempt.
actions.evidence: The post-Prepare commit changes only the canonical P08 report.

actions.title: Confirm the primary worktree is clean
actions.instruction: Inspect the primary worktree after the report commit and before Check.
actions.rationale: A dirty primary worktree breaks the exact live state that P08 verifies.
actions.expected_result: Git prints no output for the primary worktree.
actions.recovery: If Git prints a change, preserve it and do not run Check until you understand its source. Do not delete prepared worktrees to silence the result.
actions.evidence: The primary worktree is clean at the point Check observes it.

actions.title: Run the external checkpoint
actions.instruction: Run the installed Academy Check command from the numbered attempt after the report-only commit and clean-state review.
actions.rationale: Check independently compares the committed report with the externally recorded live fixture.
actions.expected_result: Academy reports checkpoint P08-repository-hygiene: passed and records progress only when the exact fixture and report agree.
actions.recovery: If Check fails, preserve every resource and read the failed predicate. Use Reset only for a separately retained retry.
actions.evidence: A passing external verdict follows the exact report-only commit and live fixture verification.

actions.title: Return to main after a passing attempt
actions.instruction: Run this only after Check passes and the primary worktree is clean. Leave the completed attempt branch and linked worktrees intact.
actions.rationale: Returning to main ends active work without deleting the evidence-bearing attempt.
actions.expected_result: The primary checkout is on main while the completed P08 attempt remains available for verification.
actions.recovery: If Git refuses to switch, preserve the message and inspect the current state. Do not remove a worktree or force a branch change.
actions.evidence: The successful attempt remains intact after returning to main.

actions.title: Preserve a failed attempt and prepare a retry
actions.instruction: Use Reset only after a failed attempt that you need to retain. It archives the attempt and prepares the next numbered one through installed Academy authority.
actions.rationale: A numbered retry preserves evidence instead of rewriting the failed state.
actions.expected_result: Academy retains the failed P08 attempt and switches to a new numbered attempt with a fresh fixture.
actions.recovery: If Reset stops, preserve its message and return to the Recovery guidance. Do not manually remove refs or worktrees.
actions.evidence: The failed attempt remains available and the retry has a distinct numbered branch.
